notes: Keep this file focused on Production Auth And Workspace Management only.
Feature 15 work is starting on branch zheng while Feature 4 canvas/storyboard work remains active in the shared project context.
First implementation slice is planning and foundation preparation only; do not implement auth code until auth-account-002 starts.
Email/password registration is the first real login path. GitHub and Google OAuth are disabled UI placeholders until a later provider-integration task.
The account model uses organization membership roles: owner, admin, editor, viewer. Do not add a coarse global admin/user shortcut.
Registration creates a default workspace and owner membership for the registering user.
Sessions use HttpOnly cookies; browser JavaScript must not store bearer tokens.
Invitations, email verification, and password reset use a development outbox first; no production email provider is in scope for the first pass.
Billing is owner-visible Coming soon UI only until a later billing task.
Existing workspace and Script/Task flows must remain usable after login and must not be broken for ongoing canvas work.

small_features.title: Plan account system implementation scope
small_features.user_visible_behavior: The product team has a clear, verifiable account-system implementation path before backend auth or account UI code is written.
scope: Decompose Production Auth And Workspace Management into small implementation slices.

Define the account model defaults: email/password registration, default workspace ownership, membership roles, HttpOnly cookie sessions, disabled OAuth placeholders, development email outbox, and Billing Coming soon.
Record how account work proceeds on branch zheng without erasing the current Feature 4 storyboard/canvas context.
Define write scope, acceptance criteria, verification plan, risks, and evaluator rubric for the first account-system slice.
acceptance_criteria: feature_tasks/15.json contains auth-account-001 through auth-account-007 with scope, acceptance criteria, and verification guidance.
sprint-contract.md describes the Feature 15 planning slice, write scope, out-of-scope work, implementation defaults, and verification plan.
feature_list.json records auth-account-001 as Feature 15 branch work while preserving Feature 4 context.
progress.md and session-handoff.md record the account-system branch start and baseline verification evidence.
evaluator-rubric.md is initialized for Feature 15 and records an evaluator score over 140 before the slice is accepted.
JSON validation, git diff checks, and the standard startup path pass after artifact updates.
verification: Run .\init.ps1 before artifact edits and after artifact edits.
Parse feature_list.json and feature_tasks/15.json as JSON.
Run .\scripts\initialize-evaluator-rubric.ps1 before evaluator scoring.
Run git diff --check.
Use a reviewer/evaluator pass to confirm the planning artifacts match AGENTS.md and the agreed account-system defaults.

small_features.title: Create account persistence foundation
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Account, workspace, membership, session, and email-token state can be stored durably instead of using local or in-memory placeholders.
scope: Add SQLAlchemy database session/Base and Alembic configuration.
Add users, organizations, memberships, refresh sessions, and development outbox/token tables.
Add seed/test fixtures only where needed for local verification.
Keep project, asset, task, and history persistence out of this slice unless needed for foreign-key boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Migrations create durable account tables with organization membership roles owner, admin, editor, and viewer.
Password hashes are stored; plaintext passwords are never stored.
Registration prerequisites are represented in persistence without adding UI or route behavior yet.
Database tests cover model constraints and role defaults.
verification: Run backend pytest for account persistence.
Run backend ruff.
Run .\init.ps1 after artifact updates.

small_features.title: Implement registration, login, session, and account APIs
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users can register, log in, stay signed in through HttpOnly cookies, log out, view their profile, and select an active workspace.
scope: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/register, POST /api/v1/auth/login, POST /api/v1/auth/refresh, POST /api/v1/auth/logout, GET /api/v1/auth/me, GET /api/v1/accounts, and POST /api/v1/accounts/active.
Registration creates a default organization/workspace and owner membership.
Use HttpOnly cookies for session transport.
Do not implement GitHub or Google OAuth routes in this slice.
acceptance_criteria: Register and login set server-owned session cookies.
Refresh rotates or validates refresh session state without exposing tokens to browser JavaScript.
Logout revokes the current session.
Accounts list only organizations visible to the authenticated user.
Active organization selection validates membership.
verification: Run backend auth API pytest.
Run backend ruff.
Run focused frontend API/client tests if web clients are added.

small_features.title: Apply actor context and RBAC to existing APIs
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Existing project and generation APIs honor login, active workspace, and role permissions while staying usable in local development.
scope: Create backend actor context resolution for user_id, org_id, role, request_id, and optional project_id.
Protect existing Script Node and Task routes with role checks.
Keep Editor able to save and generate, Viewer read-only, and Owner/Admin able to manage workspace-level resources.
Preserve local /workspace development through registration/login and test fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated requests to protected APIs fail clearly with 401.
Authenticated users cannot access organizations or project resources they do not belong to.
Role checks distinguish viewer read-only behavior from editor generation behavior.
Existing Script Node tests are updated without weakening provider/model verification.
verification: Run backend pytest for auth plus Script/Task API authorization.
Run existing Script Node backend tests.
Run web workspace tests and typecheck.

small_features.title: Build login, registration, and workspace selection UI
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users can create an account, sign in, select a workspace, and see real account context in the app shell instead of the Studio Admin placeholder.
scope: Add login and registration routes using the existing design system and TriplD/shadcn components where appropriate.
Add workspace selection or confirmation UI after authentication.
Replace the top-bar placeholder account label with real user/workspace/role state.
Show GitHub and Google OAuth as disabled Coming soon controls.
acceptance_criteria: Login and registration forms call backend auth APIs and show validation errors.
Successful login or registration leads to an active workspace context.
Top bar no longer implies a fake Studio Admin account.
Disabled OAuth controls explain that provider login is not implemented yet.
verification: Run focused web tests for auth pages and top bar state.
Run full web tests, typecheck, and build.
Run Browser E2E for register to workspace entry.

small_features.title: Build full account center MVP
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users can manage profile, workspace settings, members, roles, password/security flows, and see honest placeholders for OAuth and Billing.
scope: Add account center routes for profile, workspace settings, members, security, OAuth placeholders, and Billing Coming soon.
Support member invitation through the development outbox, member listing, role changes, and removal.
Support password change and password reset request/confirm through development outbox tokens.
Keep Billing as owner-visible Coming soon only.
acceptance_criteria: Owner/Admin can invite, list, change roles, and remove members within their organization.
Editor and Viewer cannot manage members or Billing surfaces.
Password flows use tokenized outbox records and do not expose raw secrets.
Every disabled or not-yet-implemented button explains its unavailable state through UI.
verification: Run backend member/security pytest.
Run web account center tests.
Run Browser E2E for account center profile, member, security, and placeholder flows.

small_features.title: Close Feature 15 account system evidence
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Feature status, sprint evidence, evaluator score, and handoff notes accurately describe what account capabilities are done and what remains deferred.
scope: Update docs only where durable API/account behavior changed.
Record final verification, Browser E2E evidence, evaluator score, and known limitations.
Confirm repo remains restartable through .\init.ps1.
Leave branch ready for review without committing or pushing unless explicitly requested.
acceptance_criteria: feature_list.json records Feature 15 status accurately after implementation and verification.
sprint-contract.md, evaluator-rubric.md, progress.md, and session-handoff.md contain final evidence.
No unavailable frontend account action is shown without a clear unavailable-state explanation.
Final verification covers backend, frontend, build, JSON, git diff, and Browser E2E paths.
verification: Run all relevant backend and frontend verification commands.
Run final .\init.ps1.
Run Browser E2E for the account workflow.
Run git status and report remaining changes.
